policy_simulation.label: Simulation · assumed effects, not observed uplift
policy_simulation.assumption: At due+3, an eligible friendly or firm reminder has an assumed 5%, 10%, or 20% chance of advancing settlement by up to 3, 5, or 7 days. The table is a deterministic sensitivity analysis, not a causal estimate from observed reminder outcomes.

model_comparison_note: Release model selected: cox. Selection uses validation integrated Brier across LightGBM (0.084), pooled Kaplan–Meier (0.076), and Cox PH (0.051); the held-out cohort is not used for model selection.

model_card.selection_rule: Lowest inverse-probability-of-censoring-weighted integrated Brier score on the time-separated validation cohort; candidates are LightGBM, pooled Kaplan–Meier, and Cox PH.
known_limits: Synthetic-only training cohort; external public-data evaluation is reported separately.
Paid-only date error and interval coverage exclude invoices censored before final payment; IPCW survival scores include observed censored records.
The final artifact is refit through the current cutoff after evaluation; validation calibration is transferred and should be monitored.

deployed_forecast_evaluation.scoring_path: production model scoring from point-in-time invoice and client history at each checkpoint, conditional survival, client-history tail blend, validation-fitted 14-day calibration, mature overdue recovery ceiling, and promise scenario overlay
deployed_forecast_evaluation.brier_method: Conditional inverse-probability-of-censoring-weighted Brier score; known payments within a horizon are positive outcomes, invoices observed through the horizon are negative outcomes, and earlier censoring contributes zero over the at-risk denominator.
deployed_forecast_evaluation.limitations: Synthetic held-out replay at due-date +1/+30/+90 days using each checkpoint's observable facts. Conditional horizons beyond the original 180-day observation window are right-censored. The synthetic cohort has no observed promise-adherence outcomes, so its illustrative promise overlay receives no independent adherence validation.

ablation_metrics.note: Weekday is already absent from the deployed v6 schema; this equals the full LightGBM feature set.
Retrained after removing reminder count and recency.
Retrained using only prior settled-client history features.

interval_calibration.method: split conformal interval correction fitted on validation paid invoices, with per-currency calibration when n ≥ 20
interval_calibration.caveat: Paid-only calibration; censoring, small currency slices, and client dependence limit marginal coverage guarantees.

validation_residual_drift.method: two-sample Kolmogorov–Smirnov test on signed paid-invoice P50 residuals
validation_residual_drift.caveat: Paid-only residual diagnostic; it is a drift check, not a censoring-adjusted calibration guarantee.

selection.rule: Use the recent window only when earlier-versus-recent validation residual KS p < 0.05 and the recent window has at least 20 paid invoices; never select a window using test outcomes.

drift_backtest.lead_time_definition: Days from signal snapshot to the first subsequent late invoice due date, among true-positive clients with a future missed due date.

plain_delay_rule.name: median delay of the last three settled invoices > 1.5× the preceding median

drift_backtest.label_caveat: Evaluation positives are generator-defined: no invoice issue in the next 90 days, or future paid-invoice median delay at least 7 days above the preceding median.
drift_backtest.outcome_definition: No invoice issue in the next 90 days, or future paid-invoice median delay at least 7 days above the preceding median.

censor_aware_evaluation.metrics: Uno concordance, time-dependent AUC, and integrated Brier use right-censoring-aware estimators; paid-only date errors remain descriptive.

calibration_30d.method: inverse probability of censoring weighted; events by horizon and invoices observed through horizon

residual_drift.method: two-sample Kolmogorov–Smirnov test on signed paid-invoice P50 residuals
residual_drift.caveat: Paid-only residual diagnostic; it is a drift check, not a censoring-adjusted calibration guarantee.

backtest.interval_label: Validation-calibrated coverage interval; P10/P50/P90 dates separately come from the displayed survival curve.

caveat: These synthetic-cohort metrics verify the pipeline only; they do not establish real-world forecast accuracy.
